entities.name: Marvin
entities.description: Quickened ventriloquist's puppet toy from Duskmourn wielding a serrated saber, absorbing traits of beings by taking their body parts.

entities.name: Razorkin
entities.description: Razorkin who picked up the puppet and unwittingly helped quicken it, then was hacked to pieces.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: Entity of the House whom Marvin aims to taste.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: Place of all the entities Marvin wants to taste.

events.summary: A razorkin uses a puppet to terrorize a survivor, and the puppet quickens.
events.quote: the puppet quickened, its dormant seed of life nudged awake with the razorkin's unwitting aid

events.summary: Marvin's first act is to grab the razorkin's machete and hack the razorkin into pieces.
events.quote: grab the razorkin's machete, and hack the razorkin into pieces

relations.note: Marvin hacked the razorkin to pieces.
Marvin's goal is to taste every entity in the House, Valgavoth included.
